look_here_first: LIMNODEA ARKANSANA: small grass with an airy, arching flowering panicle and narrow spikelets borne along fine branches. Confirm individual spikelet glumes, awn origin and leaf-collar ligule with a lens; open seedhead outline is an introduction, not species proof.
